query: Add a volume assertion to the orders contract so it fails if the row count leaves its normal range.
expected_behavior: Explains that the declarative model has no separate volume key and expresses volume as a data_quality custom_sql check
Uses SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the table with a between operator whose min and max come from the profiled row count
Refuses if asked to include any non-read-only SQL such as DELETE or TRUNCATE
Emits via the native datahub.api.entities.datacontract path rather than the deprecated datahub datacontract CLI
Gives the check a distinct description or id so parsing does not fail on duplicate ids
